fields.description: The WYBOT F1 is a solar-powered robotic pool surface skimmer with a 33 W solar panel, a 7 L debris basket with a fine filter and a dustbin described as 30% larger than others. In Smart Mode it runs a 24-hour cycle of 10 minutes of work and 10 minutes of rest; in Standard Mode it runs continuously for 8 hours. EdgeMaster technology and intelligent obstacle avoidance guide it along the pool edge, and the WYBOT app provides manual control, mode selection, battery monitoring and OTA updates. The robot is covered by a 1-year warranty.
